#Check to see if they are all within their own mean or beyond
CEWL_Data |> 
  group_by(Indiv_Lizard) |> 
  mutate(IDMean = mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         IDSD   = sd(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         In2SD = (`TEWL [g/(m2h)]` >= IDMean - 2 * IDSD) &
           (`TEWL [g/(m2h)]` <= IDMean + 2 * IDSD)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarize(Within2SD = sum(In2SD, na.rm = TRUE),
            Outside2SD = sum(!In2SD, na.rm = TRUE)) 
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   Within2SD Outside2SD
##       <int>      <int>
## 1      1265          0
#average CEWL values & find cv
CEWL_Average <- CEWL_Data |> 
  group_by(Indiv_Lizard) |> 
  mutate(CEWL = mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         CEWL_cv = sd(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`, na.rm = TRUE) 
         /mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c(`AmbT [C]`, `AmbRH [%]`, CEWL, CEWL_cv),
      mean, .names = "{.col}_mean"), .groups = "drop")
Lizard_Data_All <- Hydric_Phys |> 
  full_join(CEWL_Average,
            by = "Indiv_Lizard") |> 
  mutate(SexGravid = paste(Sex, `Gravid?`, sep = "_"),
         Es = 0.611 * exp((17.502*`AmbT [C]_mean`)/(`AmbT [C]_mean`+240.97)),
         Lab_VPD = Es - (Es*(`AmbRH [%]_mean`/100))) |> 
  select(!Es) |> 
  filter(!Sex == "J") |> 
  mutate(Campus = dplyr::recode(Campus,
                                "SCR" = "Scripps",
                                "CSM" = "CSUSM"),
         LizardID = str_replace(LizardID, "_0", "_")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(Posm_mean = Avg_Posm)

Lizard_Data_All$SiteSeason <- interaction(Lizard_Data_All$Site, Lizard_Data_All$Season)
CEWL_outliers <- Lizard_Data_All |>
  group_by(Site, Season) |>
  mutate(Q1 = quantile(CEWL_mean, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
         Q3 = quantile(CEWL_mean, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
         IQR = Q3 - Q1,
         outlier = CEWL_mean < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) |
                   CEWL_mean > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)) |> 
  ungroup()

CEWL_outliers |> 
  filter(outlier) |>
  select(LizardID, Site, Season, CEWL_mean)

SVL <- read_xlsx("Cool Lizards SVL.xlsx") |> 
  select(!"...9") |> 
  mutate(
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, "on", "ON"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, "off", "OFF"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, " ", "")
  ) |> 
  filter(!`Liz ID` %in% c(
    "CSUSB_ON_01_0003",   # replicate of Off_01, mislabeled
    "CP_OFF_12_0001",     # crooked, use the other scan
    "CSUSB_ON_06_0001",   # a replicate with a hand in the way
    "UCLA_OFF_01_0002",   # dorsal replicate
    "PEP_ON_51_0001"      # replicate
  )) |> 
  mutate(
    `Liz ID` = str_remove(`Liz ID`, "_000[1234]$"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`, "_0([0-9]+)$", "_\\1"),
    Site = str_extract(`Liz ID`, "ON|OFF"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`,"PEP(?!P)","PEPP"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`,"SC(?!R)","SCR")) |> 
    #Campus = str_extract(`Liz ID`, "SDSU|CP|CLU|CSM|CSUSM|CSULB|CSUSB|HMC|PEPP|SCR|SC|UCLA|PEP|WC") originally used for combining datasheet & locating errors. Ignore this line
  rename(LizardID = `Liz ID`) |> 
  mutate(SiteSeason = interaction(Site, Season)) |> 
  select(!c("SVL 1","SVL 2", "SVL3", "STDEV", "CV")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(SVL = `Average`)
## New names:
## • `` -> `...9`
Combined_Lizard <- left_join(Lizard_Data_All, SVL,
                             by = c("LizardID","Site","Season", "SiteSeason"))
  
Pieg_Model <- lm(log(Mass) ~ log(SVL), data = Combined_Lizard, na.action = na.exclude)

Lizard_Master <- Combined_Lizard |> 
  mutate(Sion = Mass / SVL,
         Pieg = log(Mass) - predict(Pieg_Model, newdata = Combined_Lizard),
         Condition = residuals(Pieg_Model)) #this is the exact same as "Pieg", different format

# Season*Site + Season*Condition + Site*Condition
lmer_CEWL <- lmer(CEWL_mean ~ 
                    #Season*Site + Season*Condition
                    Season*Site*Condition 
                  #3 way and Condition*Site have high p-values but it is good practice to keep in higher-order interactions if we expected there to be a trend
                  + Lab_VPD + (1|Campus)  + Posm_mean + SexGravid 
                  + Ecto_Presence 
                  #variable that could be removed but would make sense to check for, even if not significant, it is good practice to keep & not change post hoc
                  , data = filter(Lizard_Master,!is.na(CEWL_mean)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_CEWL) 
## Type III Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method
##                        Sum Sq Mean Sq NumDF  DenDF F value    Pr(>F)    
## Season                 85.909  85.909     1 289.68 11.6666 0.0007273 ***
## Site                   97.182  97.182     1 286.06 13.1975 0.0003322 ***
## Condition              60.265  60.265     1 286.03  8.1841 0.0045374 ** 
## Lab_VPD               111.236 111.236     1 291.96 15.1060 0.0001258 ***
## Posm_mean              35.327  35.327     1 290.83  4.7975 0.0292950 *  
## SexGravid             160.794  80.397     2 284.51 10.9181 2.701e-05 ***
## Ecto_Presence           4.481   4.481     1 289.21  0.6086 0.4359564    
## Season:Site           100.885 100.885     1 283.72 13.7003 0.0002575 ***
## Season:Condition       87.519  87.519     1 284.78 11.8852 0.0006512 ***
## Site:Condition          6.607   6.607     1 284.36  0.8973 0.3443234    
## Season:Site:Condition   0.305   0.305     1 282.67  0.0415 0.8387931    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
lmer_Posm <- lmer(Posm_mean ~ 
                  Season*Site*Condition 
                  #keep 3-way because it is only marginally non-significant and reveals 2-ways
                  #Season*Site + Season*Condition + Site*Condition
                  + SexGravid + (1|Campus)
                  + Ecto_Presence
                  #keeping ecto_presence, though not significant itself, reveals site*condition interaction
                  ,
                  data = filter(Lizard_Master, !is.na(Posm_mean)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_Posm)

## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
lmer_Hem <- lmer(Hematocrit ~ Season*Site*Condition 
                 + SexGravid + (1|Campus) + Ecto_Presence,
                 data = filter(Lizard_Master, !is.na(Hematocrit)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_Hem)

pred_cewl <- as.data.frame(emmeans(lmer_CEWL, ~ Season * Site))
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
okabe_ito <- c(
  "#E69F00", # orange
  "#56B4E9") # blue
#Cewl Model with background
ggplot()+
  geom_jitter(data = Lizard_Master, aes(x = Season, y = CEWL_mean, group = factor(Site)), 
                                        color = ifelse(Lizard_Master$Site == "ON", "grey50", "grey70"),
                                        fill = ifelse(Lizard_Master$Site == "ON", "grey65", "grey85"),
              width = .2, show.legend = F, shape = 21, size = 2) +
  # scale_color_manual(
  #   values = c("ON" = "grey65", 
  #              "OFF" = "grey85")) +
  # scale_color_identity()+
  geom_line(data = pred_cewl, aes(x = Season, y = emmean, color = factor(Site), group = Site)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = pred_cewl, aes(x = Season, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, color = factor(Site)), width = 0.075, size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = pred_cewl, aes(x = Season, y = emmean, color = factor(Site), group = Site), size = 2) +
  labs(y = expression("CEWL (g "* m^-2 / h^-1 *")"),
       color = "Site") +
  scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito[c(1,2)],
                     labels = c(
                       "On"  = "Urban",
                       "Off" = "Non-urban")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16))

pred_hemato <- ggpredict(lmer_Hem, terms = c("Condition", "Site", "Season"))
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = Lizard_Master, aes(x = Condition, y = Hematocrit, color = Site),
             alpha = 0.25, size = 1.7) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_hemato, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
    alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +

    data = pred_hemato, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group),
